narrative.synopsis: At Mecone, Prometheus uses sacrificial division to favor mortals. Zeus’ choice of the gleaming but inferior portion establishes a ritual order and intensifies divine resentment toward human benefit.
narrative.openingSituation: The boundary between gods and mortals needs a ritual form.
narrative.centralConflict: Prometheus turns a shared meal into a contest of appearances and power.
narrative.resolution: Zeus takes the portion of bones and fat, whether deceived or knowingly angered.
narrative.outcome: Sacrifice becomes both a bond and a reminder of conflict.
